headline: Environment Canterbury Requests Details on Fonterra's 22M Litre Raw Milk Disposal Plan
summary: Environment Canterbury asked dairy processor Fonterra for detailed information regarding plans to dump 22 million liters of raw milk. Environmental advocates called for moratoriums on dairy conversions to prevent excess milk waste.
why: Fonterra Co-operative Group is New Zealand's largest corporate entity and the world's primary dairy exporter.

impacts.name: Fonterra Co-operative Group
impacts.why: Fonterra was asked for further details on its planned 22 million liter milk disposal.
